title: Dois a Zero Também Dói
summary: Monday 2027-02-01. A photo of Vincente in a Palmeiras shirt at the Lakers game goes viral among Brazilian fans (over one million views). A private MD3 against M80 ends 0-2 for Kairos Gaming (Nuke 8-13, Train 11-13) and exposes friction between Caleb and Mold over information. The Academy beat the independent group Chalkline 2-1. A short video recorded for Brazilian fans accidentally shows a tactical board with two Train setups, forcing Kairos to change that preparation a week before the CCT.
keyEvents: 8:32 — A photo of Vincente at the Lakers game is shared by a Brazilian fan; his nickname FLACOGOMEZ (Flaco López + Gustavo Gómez) is identified; it exceeds one million views.
10:03 — Private scrim, Kairos Gaming vs M80 (slaxz-, Swisher, s1n, JBa, Lake): Nuke 8-13 (4-8 at half) and Train 11-13; M80 win 2-0; Cache not played. The M80 will travel to Dallas for IEM Dallas.
10:52–14:21 — Academy Green vs Chalkline (independent five): Inferno 13-10, Cache 9-13, Cobblestone 13-11; Academy win 2-1.
12:48 — Vincente records a short video in Portuguese explaining his nickname; it is posted by the communications team.

15:03 — Emily finds a tactical board with Train notes visible for under two seconds behind a glass door; the video was online for 43 minutes and a screenshot circulates with the caption 'Kairos accidentally leaks Train setups a week before CCT debut'.
17:08 — Emergency meeting: Vincente is not at fault; two Train configurations will be changed; no recording may show tactical boards, analysis screens or preparation material without specific review.
20:14 — Luk tells Caleb a good system must not replace thinking; Caleb asks Cameron to review Train rounds with him.
consequences: Kairos modifies timings and defensive responses of two Train setups before the CCT.
New communications rule: no filming of tactical material without review; training rooms stay available for authorised interviews.
canonIntroduced: Private scrims: M80 2-0 Kairos Gaming (2027-02-01); Academy Green 2-1 Chalkline.
Vincente's Palmeiras photo goes viral in Brazil on 2027-02-01.
A tactical board with Train notes was accidentally shown in a video on 2027-02-01.
continuityNotes: Vincente's shirt is green in this episode and blue (Palmeiras 2026) in Episode 126; both are recorded as narrated.
The M80 series is recorded as a private scrim; M80's own results at IEM Dallas are in Episodes 125-126.
realWorldReferences: M80, Palmeiras, LA Galaxy and the Lakers are real-world references.

sourceReferences.locator: Episódio 122 — Dois a Zero Também Dói

confirmedFacts: Kairos Gaming lost 0-2 to M80 in a private MD3 (Nuke 8-13, Train 11-13).
Academy Green beat Chalkline 2-1 (Inferno 13-10, Cache 9-13, Cobblestone 13-11).
Vincente Galán's parents emigrated from Curitiba before he was born; he grew up in Tulsa and later in California and follows Palmeiras.
Seven days remain before the CCT; no opponent or bracket is yet known to the team.
unconfirmedDetails: How many people saw the video or the screenshots before removal.
notes: Kairos Gaming is the public name of the Counter-Strike Main team.
